title: Marketing Manager
summary: Build relationships and help customers understand suitable solar solutions.
responsibilities: Plan local marketing campaigns and follow up on customer enquiries.
Coordinate site-assessment enquiries with the technical team.
Maintain lead records, prepare proposals with approved pricing and report campaign performance.
requirements: Clear communication and customer relationship skills.
Experience with sales planning, spreadsheets and lead management.
An interest in renewable energy; solar-sector experience is useful.

title: Accountant
summary: Support accurate financial records and organised day-to-day accounting.
responsibilities: Record invoices, receipts, payments and expense vouchers.
Reconcile bank statements and maintain supplier and customer ledgers.
Prepare supporting records for tax filings and coordinate with the appointed accountant or auditor.
requirements: Working knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting software.
Confidence with spreadsheets, reconciliation and documentation.
Attention to detail and responsible handling of financial information.

title: Back Office Executive
summary: Keep customer records, documents and internal coordination running smoothly.
responsibilities: Maintain enquiry, quotation and service-request records.
Coordinate appointments and communicate updates to customers.
Organise project paperwork and support procurement and office administration.
requirements: Good computer, email and spreadsheet skills.

title: Electrical Technician
summary: Support safe installation, inspection and maintenance of solar electrical systems.
responsibilities: Assist with cable routing, equipment installation and connections under authorised supervision.
Support testing, fault reporting and preventive maintenance.
Follow site safety procedures, use appropriate protective equipment and maintain service records.
requirements: Relevant electrical trade training or practical electrical experience.
Ability to follow wiring diagrams and technical instructions.
Awareness of electrical isolation, site safety and safe tool use.
